EvidenceSource.description:
A single, structured piece of evidence for one or more claims.

Goes inside `EvidenceEntry.items` (preferred over the legacy bare-URL
`sources` list). A URL alone doesn't tell the matcher *what* it
supports; this structure binds a URL to a human-readable claim and
the field name(s) it backs, so an audit can verify each claim
individually.
EvidenceSource.title: EvidenceSource

description:
Per-(student-advisor, candidate) connection signals.

All fields optional. The matcher takes the **max** strength across present
signals (no stacking). `sources` is required by the data-integrity policy
for any non-default claim — empty `sources` makes the path count as
unverified.

Strict schema: unknown keys raise. Negative counts / out-of-range floats
raise.

small_team_coauthor_5y.description: Distinct papers in last 5y where both names appear, ≤10 total authors
small_team_coauthor_5y.title: Small Team Coauthor 5Y

big_collab_papers_5y.description: Distinct papers in last 5y where both names appear, >10 authors (alphabetical author list bulk; weak signal)
big_collab_papers_5y.title: Big Collab Papers 5Y

shared_grant_count_5y.description: NSF/NIH/DOE shared-grant count between advisor and candidate in last 5y
shared_grant_count_5y.title: Shared Grant Count 5Y

co_mentored_student_count.description: Students jointly mentored by advisor and candidate (committee co-mentorship counts)
co_mentored_student_count.title: Co Mentored Student Count

prior_institution_overlap_years.description: Years overlapped at the same institution before either's current role
prior_institution_overlap_years.title: Prior Institution Overlap Years

conference_session_overlap_5y.description: Conferences in last 5y where both presented at the same session/track
conference_session_overlap_5y.title: Conference Session Overlap 5Y

most_recent_connection_year.description: Year of most recent direct interaction. Drives the recency multiplier (0–2y → 1.0, 3–5y → 0.85, 6–10y → 0.60, 10y+ → 0.35, None → 0.75).
most_recent_connection_year.title: Most Recent Connection Year
